description: This file defines a React component 'TopModelView' that displays a list of top models with statistics. It includes UI controls to toggle between a chart view (using '@tremor/react' BarChart) and a table view (using a custom DataTable component). The component uses internal state and utility functions for formatting numbers, and defines interfaces for props and data structures.

methods.name: TopModelView
methods.description: React functional component that renders a toggleable view (chart or table) of top models with statistics.
